text:
The Sith Lords Restored Content Modification (TSLRCM, or just RCM) is a modification made by volunteer fans, intended to restore much of the content cut from Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords, mainly due to its rushed release (it was barely a year in development). It also addresses a multitude of bugs plaguing the original game due to this rushed release, some of which can block existing content.

Steam users are advised to download from its Workshop as long as no other mods are used, since compatibility cannot be guaranteed.
title: Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords/Restored Content Mod
